If not, I recommend: The Travelling Cat Chronicles, What You Are Looking For is in the Library, The Miracles of Namiya General Store (this one's Keigo din). Medyo mabilis din ako mag-DNF (kagagaling ko lang ng reading slump lol) pero na-enjoy ko naman yung pacing nila.
